name: Riso
description: A three-ink risograph print on cream paper: halftone screens at their own angles, overprints instead of mixed colours, plates a few pixels off register, ink dropouts that sparkle in the darks. Flat, bright, a little worn, on 2s. A spark gains a ray each era and ends as the answer: a market stall where a small blueberry character picks a fresh orange under a striped awning.
